stem: Which statement best presents the author’s claim on the best way to plan leisure activities?

options.label: A
options.text: Agree on plans in advance, but be willing to adjust plans if necessary.

options.label: B
options.text: Schedule time for events, but do not determine the activity in advance.

options.label: C
options.text: Commit to having fun, even when activities are scheduled in advance.

options.label: D
options.text: Avoid making plans ahead of time, and have fun when the time is right.
